# Version 4.151.0 (Unreleased)
> **Vulkan support and engine sync**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.151.0 adds a Vulkan Silk.NET package and syncs the Skia m151 engine. This release introduces the new SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET package, syncs upstream Skia chrome/m151 bug fixes, expands platform support with Nano Server font rendering via FreeType, and fixes a native memory leak in SKImage raster creation.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Engine

- **Skia m151 upstream sync** — Merged the Skia chrome/m151 bug-fix stream, keeping the bundled engine current with upstream fixes. ([#4537](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4537), [#4538](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4538))

## API Surface

- **New SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET package** — A new NuGet package provides Vulkan backend integration via the Silk.NET abstraction layer, enabling GPU-accelerated rendering on Android and Linux. ([#4527](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4527))

## Bug Fixes

- **Native memory leak in SKImage.Create fixed** — A CoTaskMem pixel-buffer allocated in the raster failure path was not freed; it is now released correctly. ([#4455](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4455))
- **String allocation and uniform map performance** — Eliminated an intermediate string allocation in the GetEncodedText null-terminated path and pre-sized the SKRuntimeEffectUniforms lookup map to reduce overhead. ([#4498](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4498), [#4512](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4512))

## Platform

- **Nano Server font support via FreeType** — Windows Nano Server containers now get font rendering through FreeType, resolving a long-standing gap for containerized Windows workloads. — ❤️ [@jeffska](https://github.com/jeffska) ([#4280](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4280))
- **Containerized test platforms: Azure Linux, Alpine/musl, Nano Server** — CI now validates SkiaSharp on Azure Linux, Alpine musl-libc, and Nano Server containers, expanding the supported platform matrix. ([#4515](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4515))
